name: heart-disease-risk-prediction
description: Production-ready heart-disease risk prediction — leakage-free XGBoost pipeline with per-patient SHAP explainability, served via FastAPI + Streamlit, Dockerised and tested with CI.

paragraphs: A leakage-free, end-to-end machine-learning system that predicts the presence of heart disease from 11 routine clinical measurements — served as both a FastAPI REST service and an interactive Streamlit app, with real per-patient SHAP explanations.
🔗 Live Demo: · 📖 API Docs: run uvicorn api.main:app → /docs

Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death worldwide. This project trains a calibrated classifier on the UCI / Cleveland heart-disease dataset and exposes it through clean, production-style interfaces. It is built to demonstrate the full ML lifecycle — data validation, leakage-free preprocessing, model comparison, hyperparameter tuning, explainability, testing, and deployment — not just a notebook that prints an accuracy score.
features: 🔬 Leakage-free pipeline — imputation + scaling live inside an sklearn
Pipeline, so they are fit on training folds only. (The original notebook imputed the full dataset before splitting — a textbook leak.)
🤖 Model comparison + tuning — Logistic Regression, Random Forest, SVM and
XGBoost compared by stratified CV; the winner is tuned with RandomizedSearchCV and the tuned model is the one that ships.
🧠 Real SHAP explanations — genuine per-patient feature contributions
